notes: Expands Mathematics Term 2 Week 1 measurement questions from a few repetitive formats to 15 clear question families plus a varied classic generator.
Removes the confusing non-zero ruler-start pencil format from the Week 1 pool; ruler-reading questions now start at 0 cm.
Adds variety for cm/m unit choice, ruler reading, longer/shorter/equal comparisons, measuring tools, longest/shortest, and school-distance questions.
Moves Tournament questions higher by reducing unused arena height and gives the timer its own visible row directly below the question.
Applies the expanded Term 2 Week 1 Math pool to Adventure, Team Battle, Tournament, and Class Boss curriculum question generators.
